name: demo-playwright-typescript-for-google-maps
summary: A typed Playwright + TypeScript reference for Google Maps interaction patterns. Never executed against live google.com.
description: This repo shows three typed Playwright TypeScript checks against Google Maps: page title contains 'Google Maps', a search via [aria-label="Search Google Maps"] plus Enter whose resulting URL contains the query, and clicking [aria-label="Zoom in"] increases the zoom level embedded in the URL's @lat,lng,zoomz fragment. Google's Terms of Service restrict automated querying, so this code is a reference only and must never be run against live google.com in CI or automated tooling.
